notes: Verified: web/src/silentSso.test.ts + silent-sso-boot.test.tsx (16 tests) pass; Go TestASilentSignInIsOnlyAttemptedWhenTheAdministratorAllowsIt and TestASilentRefusalCarriesOnlyAnOnSiteDeepLink pass against a throwaway postgres:16 (the suite is skipped without VENDRA_TEST_DSN, so a plain `go test` does not exercise the callback change).

Tests genuinely fail on the pre-change code: the Go assertion at internal/httpapi/oidc_silent_test.go:87 now requires the returnTo suffix, and the boot test at web/src/silent-sso-boot.test.tsx:76 requires the SSO href to carry returnTo — neither holds on main.

Redirect safety: the refusal's returnTo comes from the encrypted flow cookie (already run through safeReturnTo at the start leg) and is re-sanitised in silentRefusalLocation (internal/httpapi/oidc.go:104); the client's loginDestination re-checks with the TS safeReturnTo before navigate()/the SSO href, and the server sanitises again on /api/auth/oidc/start. The TS check is looser than the Go one (no control-char/scheme check) but a leading single '/' is sufficient for an in-app navigate and the server re-validates.

Behaviour slightly broader than the title: the SSO button now carries the current address as returnTo on every in-place login screen, not only after a refused silent attempt (web/src/App.tsx:461). Previously SSO from /suppliers/42 landed on '/'. The commit message does describe this ('is the address itself anywhere else'), so it is documented, just worth knowing.

A crafted /login?sso=none&returnTo=%2Fregister sends an employee to the supplier registration screen after a password login (App.tsx:159 renders it regardless of session). Same class as the pre-existing OIDC returnTo behaviour, not introduced here.
docs/ADMIN_GUIDE.pdf binary was rebuilt alongside the .md; expected per project convention.
